AnyEngineParts.Description: Turbochargers and belt-driven superchargers with blow-off valves, a wastegate with antilag and launch control, oil ports, air filters and intercoolers, a Dyno sensor, and a 1-4 rotor rotary engine. Anymaker 0.1.25 only.

GpsPart.Description: Adds a GPS Sensor part with position, altitude, heading, pitch, roll, speed, acceleration and waypoint distance/bearing data channels. Single player only. Uses the experimental SDK; Anymaker 0.1.25 only.
